function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - (bins == 0) * item  # Avoid negative values if bin is empty
    # Prevent division by zero and handle edge cases
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining <= 0, 1e-10, remaining)
    # Priority is higher when remaining capacity is just above item size
    # This encourages bins that can fit the item with minimal waste
    priority_scores = 1 / (safe_remaining + 1e-10) * (item / safe_remaining)
    # Normalize by inverse of waste ratio (waste = remaining - item)
    waste = safe_remaining - item
    waste = np.where(waste < 0, 1e-10, waste)
    priority_scores = 1 / (waste + 1e-10)
    return priority_scores
